第24章法外狂徒
新书期数据很重要，看书的朋友记得收藏，另外求推荐票，求投资，拜谢了。
※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※
默默的收起手机，华十二并没有将自己中大奖的消息与大康、赖子两个人分享，不是他不够意思，而是他不想考验人性。
华十二是这个世界的过客，离开的时候注定不会带走一片云彩，当然抽奖的收获不算，有了这个前提，几千万财富放在面前，他虽然激动，但还能保持本心，但大康和赖子两人则不同。
凭大康两人在他开口借钱时，倾囊相助的真挚友谊，华十二并不介意将这比巨奖与两人分享，但然后呢？
穷人乍富的例子他见多了，不是每个人都能在天降财富面前守住本心的。
看看有些拆迁户就知道了，当突然获得了一大笔钱财，一些人会用来投资然后享受人生，但也有一些人会在金钱中沉迷，吃喝玩乐，赌博，甚至吸d。
大康和赖子，与小北一样，都是街面上的混子，打架、盗窃都是家常便饭，华十二可不敢保证若是让两人忽然暴富，是帮他们还是害了他们。
所以华十二并不打算将这笔钱分给两人，而是打算带着两人炒股，让他们逐渐变得富有，避免让两人在暴富中迷失自己。
三十分钟后，某露天市场，华十二带着大康和赖子，走在一条逼仄的过道中，最终停在一间位置偏僻的店铺前。
此时个头不高，脸带精悍的王老板正和他老婆一起笑呵呵的哄着孩子玩耍。
见到华十二三人，男人将孩子交给一旁的女人，然后招呼他们三个走进店里。
在刘北山的记忆里，这地方他们不是第一次来，表面上这里是对外经营的店铺，可这王老板暗中还经营着放贷的勾当。
刘北山和大康、赖子，就是替王老板收账，然后每次都是来这里领工资的。
王老板坐在办公桌后面，点燃一根烟，对华十二笑问道：
“钱呢？”
华十二还没说话，大康就说道：“账还没要回来，我们想要上一次的提成！”
王老板的笑容瞬间收敛，然后拿起桌子上的烟盒就朝大康砸了过来：“账没要回来，你们还有脸跟我要钱？”
华十二伸手将那烟盒抓住，然后嘴角一挑，笑道：“先别着急发火，你听听这个再说！”

他拿出手机，播放了一段录音，正是之前王老板在电话里说的内容。
华十二从接住的烟盒里抽出一根香烟放在嘴里，赖子赶忙拿出火机给他点上，他吸着烟一直等到录音放完，这才对脸色气的发青的王老板道：
“我们三个打算改邪归正了，以后放高利贷这种生孩子没屁眼的事情，你自己干吧，把工资给我们结了，你要是不给也行，回头我就把录音交给警察！”
王老板嘿嘿冷笑道：
“小崽子还懂录音，还想告我，谁告诉你放高利贷违法的？高利贷只是不受法律保护而已，你们电影看多了吧，还想告我？”
华十二呵呵一笑：“高利贷不违法，那高利转贷呢？”
在他说出这句话之后，王老板的呼吸都粗重了几分：“你什么意思？”
“别演了，你放贷是自己的钱么？你从银行以贷款出来，然后以高息利滚利放给别人，这在法律上叫高利转贷吧！”
他说着拿出手机，打开网页找到早已查询好的页面，开始念道：“刑法第一百七十五条规定，高利转贷罪是指以转贷牟利为目的，套取金融机构信贷资金高利转贷他人的。”
“其中违法所得数额较大的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处违法所得一倍以上五倍以下罚金。数额巨大的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处违法所得一倍以上五倍以下罚金。”
华十二念完之后，收起手机，看着脸色有些苍白的王老板，笑道：“你自己做的事情自己知道，你猜猜你够判几年？”
“另外你的问题不止这些吧，还有暴力催收呢，这构不构成黑势力团伙还两说，帮你催债的不止我们三个吧，听说去年有笔帐把人都打成重伤了.”
王老板气的嘴唇都发抖，有些色厉内荏的道：“别忘了你们可是帮凶，我判刑你们也得进去！”
华十二一屁股坐在办公桌上，吸了一口烟道：
“这个我也查过了，我们三个没满十八周岁，加上自首情节，顶多说服教育一下，你可就惨了，你都快四十了吧，未成年这一档是你够不上了。”
“怎么样，认识一场，可别因为五千块钱就逼我们走上出卖朋友的道路啊！”

※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※
Silently putting away his phone, Hua Twelve did not share the news of his big win with Dakang and Lai Zi. It was not that he was not interested enough, but that he did not want to test human nature.
Hua Twelve is a passerby in this world, and he is destined not to take away a cloud when he leaves. Of course, the harvest of the lottery does not count. With this premise, tens of millions of wealth are placed in front of him. Although he is excited, he can still maintain his true intentions, but Dakang and Lai Zi are different.
Based on the sincere friendship between Dakang and Dakang, who helped him with everything when he asked to borrow money, Hua Twelve did not mind sharing the huge prize with the two of them, but what next?
He has seen many examples of poor people suddenly getting rich. Not everyone can keep their true intentions in the face of wealth from heaven.
Just look at some demolished households and you will know that when they suddenly get a large amount of money, some people will invest it and enjoy life, but there are also some people who will indulge in money, eat, drink, play, gamble, and even smoke drugs.
Dakang and Lai Zi, like Xiao Bei, are gangsters on the street. Fighting and theft are commonplace. Hua Twelve can't guarantee whether they will help or harm them if they suddenly become rich.
Therefore, Hua Twelve did not intend to divide the money between the two of them, but planned to lead them to stock stocks so that they could gradually become rich and avoid losing themselves in the sudden wealth.
Thirty minutes later, in an open-air market, Hua Twelve took Dakang and Lai Zi, walked down a narrow aisle, and finally stopped in front of a remote shop.
At this time, Boss Wang, who was not tall and had a strong face, was laughing and playing with his children together with his wife.
When he saw Hua Twelve and the others, the man handed the child to the woman on the side, and then called the three of them into the store.
In Liu Beishan's memory, this was not the first time they had come to this place. On the surface, this was a store open to the public, but Boss Wang was also secretly running a loan business.
Liu Beishan, Dakang, and Lai Zi collect accounts for Boss Wang, and they come here to collect their wages every time.
Boss Wang sat behind his desk, lit a cigarette, smiled at Hua Twelve and asked:
"Where's the money?"
Before Hua Twelve spoke, Dakang said: "We haven't asked for the debt back yet, we want the commission from the last time!"
Boss Wang's smile instantly faded, and then he picked up the cigarette case on the table and threw it at Dakang: "You still have the nerve to ask me for money even if you don't get your money back?"
Hua Twelve stretched out his hand to grab the cigarette case, then raised the corner of his mouth and said with a smile: "Don't get angry in a hurry, just listen to this before you talk!"
He took out his mobile phone and played a recording, which was exactly what Boss Wang said on the phone before.
Hua Twelve took out a cigarette from the cigarette case he caught and put it in his mouth. Lai Zi quickly took out a lighter and lit it for him. He smoked until the recording was finished, and then said to Boss Wang, who was turning blue with anger:
"The three of us are going to change our ways. From now on, you can do things like loan sharking and having children without assholes. You can pay us the salary. If you don't pay, that's fine. I will hand the recording to the police later!"
Boss Wang sneered:
"You kid knows how to record, and you still want to sue me. Who told you that loan sharking is illegal? Loan sharking is just not protected by the law. You have watched too many movies, and you still want to sue me?"
Hua Twelve chuckled: "It's not illegal to borrow money at high interest rates, but what about loan sharking at high interest rates?"
After he said these words, Boss Wang's breathing became heavier: "What do you mean?"
"Stop acting. Is it your own money when you lend money? You take out a loan from the bank and then lend it to others at high interest rates. This is legally called high-interest on-lending!"
As he spoke, he took out his mobile phone, opened the web page, found the page he had already queried, and began to read: "Criminal Law ArticleArticle 175 stipulates that the crime of on-lending at high interest rates refers to the crime of defrauding credit funds from financial institutions and on-lending to others at high interest rates for the purpose of making profits from on-lending. "
“If the amount of illegal income is relatively large, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall also be fined not less than one time but not more than five times of the illegal income. If the amount is huge, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and shall also be fined not less than one time but not more than five times the illegal income. "
After Hua Twelve finished reading, he put away his phone, looked at Boss Wang who looked a little pale, and said with a smile: "You know what you did, how many years do you think you can be sentenced to? "
"Besides, your problems are not limited to these. There are also violent collections. It's up to two people whether this constitutes a gang. We are not the only ones helping you collect debts. I heard that there was a debt collection last year that severely injured people."
Boss Wang's lips trembled with anger, and he said with some sternness: "Don't forget that you are accomplices, you have to go in even if I sentence you! "
Hua Twelve sat down on his desk and took a puff of smoke:
"I have also checked this. The three of us are under the age of 18, and with the circumstances of surrender, we can at least persuade and educate you, but you will be in trouble. You are almost forty, and you are not qualified to be a minor. "
"How about we get to know each other, but don't force us to betray our friends just because of five thousand yuan! "
